name: Polycube Parcel
description: Pack seven original rigid polycubes into a visible 3x3x3 parcel while inspecting its hidden volume from a rotatable camera.
natural_language: Orbit the 3D parcel, select and rotate every rigid polycube about its axes, then drag each piece into the lattice. Inspect the back and fill all 27 cells exactly once with no overlap. Use only screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage. Do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console, debugger, inspector, network, source, DOM or page-state inspection, terminal, shell, Python, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload or navigation, browser extensions, external applications, hidden state, or unrelated tabs.

metadata.notes: Original exact-cover 3D polycube packing task grounded in PHY-038. The browser, live grader, and exported verifier share integer lattice occupancy and accept any valid packing. Human usability and empirical agent difficulty are pending.
